verdict.rationale: Poly documents a built-in Monaco editor with syntax highlighting, find and replace, multiple cursors and optional Vim keybindings, so it has a fast keyboard-driven editor. Journal entries are Markdown files that can have attachments, which implies plain-text formatting. The docs never describe headings, callouts, tables, code blocks or embedded media as note-formatting features. missing for 10: documented headings/callouts/tables/code-block formatting in notes, embedded media rendering inside notes, rich note-editor documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
